title: An ALMA 3 mm continuum census of Westerlund 1
question: Determine mass-loss rates and mm properties of the post-main-sequence massive stars (WR, OB super/hypergiants, cool hypergiants) in the cluster Westerlund 1 from a 3 mm ALMA continuum census

what.value: 3.6 cm radio flux densities and limits used for spectral indices

evidence.quote: 3.6 cm flux densities and spectral indices taken from Do10 are also listed.

what.value: Teff and v_inf for B supergiants, WN and WC stars

evidence.quote: we have adopted the (observational) compilations of Crowther et al. (2006b) and Searle et al. (2008) for B0-B5 supergiants; Crowther (2007) and Sander et al. (2012) for WN stars

external_data.citation: Crowther et al. (2006b); Searle et al. (2008); Crowther (2007); Sander et al. (2012)

evidence.quote: Spectral type identifications have been taken from Crowther et al. (2006a) for WR stars, Clark et al. (2010) for the YHGs and RSGs

external_data.citation: Crowther et al. 2006a; Clark et al. 2010; Negueruela et al. 2010

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, re-calibration with less flagging and REMCLOUD for 30 June, phase self-cal then final amp+phase
Multi-scale mosaic CLEAN with natural weighting after subtracting Wd1-9 compact component; PB correction
Gaussian fit to Wd1-9 compact component in ALMA and FORS images and shift ALMA image
SEAC flood-fill with 5σ seed and 3σ flood thresholds on local rms; lower seeds 4.5/4σ for optically known undetected stars; cross-match with catalogues
key_parameters: σ from rms in 6×6 grid cells

recipe.method: Gaussian fits (JMFIT) to pixels >3×local rms, or SEAC island integrated flux; LAS for non-Gaussian; IRING annular profiles; 5% calibration error added in quadrature
Two-point index between 8.6 GHz (3.6 cm) Do10 fluxes and 3 mm; limits from 170 µJy/beam radio limit
Wright & Barlow free-free relation (Eq. 1) with Gaunt factor approximation, smooth wind (fcl=1)
key_parameters: Te = 0.5 Teff; d = 5 kpc; mu=1.4,Z=1,gamma=1 for OB; mu=4.0 (WN6 or earlier), 2.0 (later WN), 4.7 (WC8/9); mu=1.6, gamma=0.8, Z=0.9 for BHGs
assumptions: mm flux not affected by binarity; wind emission thermal; two non-thermal sources excluded

recipe.goal: Test whether sources are resolved and wind photosphere size
recipe.method: Compare fitted sizes with analytic mm-photosphere radius from Wright & Barlow

evidence.quote: The total 3 mm catalogue list therefore contains 101 sources.
Of the total 101 objects detected in these observations, 50 have been identified as stellar sources
